entries.en: V... It's a good thing you answered. I could probably use your help.
entries.ro: V... Bine că ai răspuns. Mi-ar prinde bine o mână de ajutor.

entries.en: Tell me when and where.
entries.ro: Spune-mi când și unde.

entries.en: What's this about?
entries.ro: Despre ce e vorba?

entries.en: Deep breaths, Panam... Tell me what's goin' on?
entries.ro: Respiră adânc, Panam... Spune-mi ce se întâmplă?

entries.en: Do you remember Saul? The leader of the clan I left?
entries.ro: Ți-l amintești pe Saul? Liderul clanului pe care l-am părăsit?

entries.en: Just tell me when and where.
entries.ro: Spune-mi doar când și unde.

entries.en: You don't know how good it is to hear that.
entries.ro: Nici nu-ți dai seama cât de bine îmi face să aud asta.

entries.en: Swing by the Aldecaldos' camp. I'll explain it all.
entries.ro: Treci pe la tabăra Aldecaldos. Îți explic tot.

entries.en: "Probably"?
entries.ro: „Probabil”?

entries.en: Don't have time for this now.
entries.ro: Acum n-am timp de asta.

entries.en: Egh, short on time right now.
entries.en_m: Mh, short on time right now.
entries.ro: Egh, n-am timp acum.

entries.en: V... it's a life and death thing. I'm serious.
entries.ro: V... e chestie de viață și de moarte. Vorbesc serios.

entries.en: Panam? Said you needed my help?
entries.en_m: Panam? Said you needed my help.
entries.ro: Panam? Ziceai că ai nevoie de mine?
entries.ro_m: Panam? Ai zis că ai nevoie de ajutorul meu.

entries.en: Yeah, I really do.
entries.ro: Da, chiar am.

entries.en: Fine – I could really use your help.
entries.ro: Bine – chiar mi-ar prinde bine o mână de ajutor.

entries.en: The Aldecaldos? Thought you'd parted ways.
entries.en_m: The Aldecaldos? Thought you parted ways.
entries.ro: Aldecaldos? Credeam că te-ai despărțit de ei.

entries.en: Ugh. Look, it's a long story. Just hurry over. I'm here.
entries.ro: Ugh. Uite, e o poveste lungă. Vino repede. Sunt aici.

entries.en: Uh-huh. Had a fallin' out or somethin'.
entries.en_m: Yeah, yeah, had a fallin' out or somethin'.
entries.ro: Mhm. V-ați certat sau ceva.
entries.ro_m: Da, da. V-ați certat sau ceva.

entries.en: Doesn't matter right now. He--
entries.ro: Nu contează acum. El--

entries.en: I got one of those on my hands, too. Sorry.
entries.en_m: Got one of those on my hands, too. Sorry.
entries.ro: Și eu am una de-astea pe cap. Scuze.

entries.en: Well, if you change your mind, I'm at the Aldecaldos' camp.
entries.ro: Dacă te răzgândești, sunt la tabăra Aldecaldos.

entries.en: They nabbed him.
entries.ro: L-au răpit.

entries.en: Can we meet?
entries.ro: Putem să ne întâlnim?

entries.en: This is just not suitable for a call, V.
entries.ro: Nu e chestie de telefon, V.

entries.en: Can you come? Will you?
entries.ro: Poți veni? Vii?
